McDowell, Mind and World, 1996, Harvard University Press. b is the 2nd edn. — same work.

Different co-authors (Barnes & McNaughton vs Quirk & Wilson), different journals (PNAS 1997 vs Neuron 2000), different years and titles ('asymmetric expansion of place fields' vs 'asymmetric shape of receptive fields'). Two distinct papers.
Messaris, Visual Literacy, 1994, Westview Press. b's title/publisher fields carry OCR spillover but it is the same book.
Milner (& Goodale), The Visual Brain in Action, Oxford University Press. Year 1995 vs 1996 (printings); b just names both authors. Same book.
The Visual Brain in Action by Milner & Goodale, Oxford University Press. Same book, minor year/printing and author-listing differences.
Milsark, existential-construction paper, Linguistic Analysis vol 3, 1977, pp ~1-29/30. Title and author (Gary/Garry) differ only by OCR/typo. Same article.
Monaghan et al., 'How arbitrary is language?', Phil. Trans. R. Soc. B vol 369, art 20130299, 2014. a's fields are OCR-mangled but same paper.
Murray et al., 'The multisensory function of the human primary visual cortex', Neuropsychologia vol 83, pp 161-169, 2016. Same paper (a title has OCR soft hyphen).
Newell & Simon, 'Computer science as empirical inquiry', CACM vol 19, pp 113-126/136, 1975/1976 (Turing lecture). Same work; year and subtitle vary.
Newell & Simon, 'Computer science as empirical inquiry', CACM vol 19, 1975/1976. Same work (year typo in a).

Nöth 'Can pictures lie?': a is a short piece in Semiotic Review of Books (1995, vol 6, pp 10-12); b is a chapter in Approaches to Semiotics (1997, vol 127, pp 133-146). Different venues, years, and lengths — distinct publications.
O'Keefe & Dostrovsky, 'The hippocampus as a spatial map...', Brain Res. vol 34, pp 171-175, 1971. a's title/journal fields are split by OCR. Same paper.
O'Keefe & Nadel, The Hippocampus as a Cognitive Map, 1978. Clarendon Press is OUP's imprint. Same book (a title has OCR space, drops Nadel from author name in b).
O'Keefe & Nadel, The Hippocampus as a Cognitive Map, 1978, Clarendon Press/OUP. Same book.
